entities.name: Michihiko Hachiya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michihiko Hachiya  was a Japanese physician who survived the atomic bombing of Hiroshima in August 1945. He kept a personal diary of his experience in the aftermath of the bombing which was later published as Hiroshima Diary in 1955.
